title: Cryptoart.social
subtitle: An auction house built around the artist’s workflow.
motivation: I wanted Farcaster notifications built into my auction house, and control over curation. I built Cryptoart.social to bring those needs into one experience.
implementation: I adapted Manifold’s marketplace contracts, deployed a subgraph, and built the website around them. Artists receive notifications when bids arrive; bidders hear when they’ve been outbid.
ownership: I own the contracts, indexing, website, and feature decisions, with design collaboration on the current UI/UX. Curator tools are part of the ongoing expansion.
grant: Recipient of Clanker Ecosystem Fund’s Builder Grant
sponsorship: Sponsored by Kismet Casa to host the auction at FarCon Rome.
tooling: I also built tests and deployment scripts, and documented LSSVM, building on sudoswap’s sudoAMM v2 protocol.
